prompt:
The section file sections/timeline-wrapped.liquid already contains working markup. It renders a timeline of event blocks. It can optionally wrap the content in an extra container <div>, whose width modifier class comes from a select setting. Each event shows an optional description <div>. The current {% schema %} block does not support these options. Do not change the markup. Replace only the schema JSON with exactly this structure, keeping the keys and array entries in this order.

Top-level keys:
- "name": "Timeline"
- "settings": an array of 3 settings, in this order:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Our story"
  2. type "checkbox", id "show_container", label "Wrap in container", default false (a JSON boolean)
  3. type "select", id "container_width", label "Container width", with options in this order: {"value":"narrow","label":"Narrow"}, {"value":"wide","label":"Wide"}. The default is "wide". Within each setting object, the key order is type, id, label, options, default.
- "blocks": an array with exactly one block type: type "event", name "Event". Its settings array, in order:
  1. type "text", id "date", label "Date"
  2. type "text", id "title", label "Title"
  3. type "richtext", id "description", label "Description"
  None of these block settings has a default.
- "max_blocks": 20 (a JSON number)
- "presets": an array with one preset: name "Timeline", and blocks containing exactly three {"type":"event"} entries.

Do not add any other keys. Change only sections/timeline-wrapped.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
